Fast, robust, accurate diffing . Contribute to ivankovic/omnidiff development by creating an account on GitHub.

Sources and methodology

View the supporting source data
  • Comments at collection: 74 — official record
  • Points at collection: 257 — official record
  • Author: FabCH — official record
  • Discussion text: I have been researching what the ultimate diff tool would look like, based on actual diffs in open source repositories. OmniDiff can diff: code (25 languages), config, images, PDFs, archives, cursors, fonts... It's fast. It can diff C++ files of tens of thousands of lines in under 100ms, on a 2023 ThinkPad T14s. It's open source. AGPLv3. It's based on real diffs. I looked at the 7400 repositories that are listed in Gentoo packages, sampled 2000 diffs and solved them manually to get a good understanding of what is needed, before putting together the diff pipelines for each content type. Incidentally, this also forms the basis of the CI pipeline, so the robustness of the codebase is quite high — official record
